'''''The Dog Stars''''' is an upcoming [[post-apocalyptic]] [[science fiction film]] directed by [[Ridley Scott]] from a screenplay by [[Mark L. Smith]], based on the 2012 novel [[The Dog Stars|of the same name]] by [[Peter Heller (writer)|Peter Heller]]. The film stars [[Jacob Elordi]], [[Josh Brolin]], [[Margaret Qualley]], and [[Guy Pearce]].

''The Dog Stars'' is scheduled to be released in the United States by [[20th Century Studios]] on August 28, 2026.

==Premise==
Set after a devastating flu pandemic that has almost eradicated humanity, the film centers on Hig, a former civilian pilot, and Bangley, a hardened former Marine as they confront outside threats and hold onto the possibility of a better life beyond where they currently live.<ref>{{cite web |last=Yang |first=Katrina |title=Ridley Scott's Post-Apocalyptic Sci-Fi Movie Sets 2026 Release Date |url=https://screenrant.com/the-dog-stars-movie-release-date-confirmed/ |website=[[Screen Rant]] |access-date=15 October 2025 |date=23 May 2025}}</ref>

==Cast==
* [[Jacob Elordi]] as Hig, a civilian pilot living with his dog
* [[Josh Brolin]] as Bangley, an aloof, gun-toting  former Marine and Hig's companion
* [[Margaret Qualley]] as Cima, a young medic and Hig's love interest
* [[Allison Janney]]
* [[Guy Pearce]] as Pops, a former Navy SEAL and Cima's father
* [[Benedict Wong]]

==Production==
===Development===
[[File: Ridley Scott (23716888011).jpg|thumb|upright|Director Ridley Scott]]
In November 2024, [[Ridley Scott]] stated that after shooting his planned [[Bee Gees]] biopic, he wanted to direct a then-unrevealed [[Science fiction|sci-fi]] film, adding that "it's already written".<ref>{{cite web |last=Lambie |first=Ryan |url=https://filmstories.co.uk/news/ridley-scott-says-hes-directing-a-mystery-sci-fi-film-exclusive/ |title=Ridley Scott says he's directing a mystery sci-fi film (exclusive) |website=Film Stories |date=1 November 2024 |access-date=1 November 2024}}</ref> This project was later revealed to be based on the 2012 novel ''[[The Dog Stars]]'' by Peter Heller, adapted by [[Mark L. Smith]] and [[Christopher Wilkinson]].<ref>{{cite web |last1=Bergesen |first1=Samantha |title=Jacob Elordi in Talks to Replace Paul Mescal in Ridley Scott's 'The Dog Stars' |url=https://www.indiewire.com/news/breaking-news/jacob-elordi-replace-paul-mescal-ridley-scott-the-dog-stars-1235082999/ |website=[[IndieWire]] |date=7 January 2025 |access-date=8 May 2025}}</ref> By this time, it was set to be Scott's next film, with filming set to begin in spring 2025.<ref name="Kroll-2024">{{cite web |last1=Kroll |first1=Justin |last2=Fleming Jr |first2=Mike |title=Ridley Scott Back In Arena With 'Gladiator II' Star Paul Mescal On 'The Dog Stars' At 20th Century |url=https://deadline.com/2024/11/ridley-scott-paul-mescal-the-dog-stars-gladiator-ii-1236161226/ |website=[[Deadline Hollywood|Deadline]] |access-date=8 November 2024 |date=8 November 2024}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |last=Stephan |first=Katcy |title=Ridley Scott and Paul Mescal to Re-Team After 'Gladiator II' on 'The Dog Stars' |url=https://variety.com/2024/film/news/ridley-scott-paul-mescal-the-dog-stars-1236205008/ |website=[[Variety (magazine)|Variety]] |access-date=8 November 2024 |date=8 November 2024}}</ref>

===Casting===
In November 2024, it was announced that [[Paul Mescal]] was in advanced negotiations to star in the film.<ref name="Kroll-2024" /><ref>{{cite web |last=Vlessing |first=Etan |title=Ridley Scott and Paul Mescal Reteam for 'The Dog Stars' |url=https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/movies/movie-news/ridley-scott-paul-mescal-the-dog-stars-1236056715/ |website=[[The Hollywood Reporter]] |access-date=15 October 2025 |date=8 November 2024}}</ref> However, due to scheduling conflicts, it was later reported in January 2025 that [[Jacob Elordi]] was in early negotiations to replace Mescal.<ref>{{cite web |last=Siegel |first=Tatiana |title=Jacob Elordi in Talks to Replace Paul Mescal in Ridley Scott's 'The Dog Stars' (EXCLUSIVE) |url=https://variety.com/2025/film/news/jacob-elordi-replace-paul-mescal-ridley-scott-the-dog-stars-1236267363/ |website=[[Variety (magazine)|Variety]] |access-date=7 January 2025 |date=7 January 2025}}</ref> In February, [[Margaret Qualley]], [[Josh Brolin]], and [[Guy Pearce]] were in final negotiations to join the cast.<ref name="Kroll-2025">{{cite web |last1=Kroll |first1=Justin |last2=Fleming Jr |first2=Mike |title=Margaret Qualley, Josh Brolin And Guy Pearce Join Jacob Elordi In Ridley Scott's Next Film 'The Dog Stars' |url=https://deadline.com/2025/02/margaret-qualley-josh-brolin-guy-pearce-jacob-elordi-ridley-scott-dog-stars-1236280702/ |website=[[Deadline Hollywood|Deadline]] |access-date=12 February 2025 |date=12 February 2025}}</ref> In early May 2025, [[Benedict Wong]] joined the cast.<ref>{{cite web |last=Grobar |first=Matt |title=Benedict Wong Joins Ridley Scott's 'The Dog Stars' |url=https://deadline.com/2025/05/the-dog-stars-adds-benedict-wong-1236389387/ |website=[[Deadline Hollywood|Deadline]] |access-date=15 October 2025 |date=8 May 2025}}</ref>

==Release==
''The Dog Stars'' is scheduled to be released in the United States on August 28, 2026.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://deadline.com/2025/12/disney-release-dates-gatto-ready-or-not-2-dog-stars-1236655242/|title=Disney Moves Around ‘Ready Or Not 2’, ‘Dog Stars’ & Pixar’s ‘Gatto’ In 2026 & 2027 Release Calendars|last=D'Alessandro|first=Anthony|date=December 22, 2025|access-date=December 22, 2025}}</ref> It was previously scheduled for March 27, 2026.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Grobar |first=Matt |date=May 22, 2025 |title=Disney Pushes Next Two 'Avengers' Movies; Dates 'The Dog Stars' & 'The Devil Wears Prada 2' |url=https://deadline.com/2025/05/next-avengers-movies-push-release-dates-dog-stars-devil-wears-prada-1236409088/ |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250522230719/https://deadline.com/2025/05/next-avengers-movies-push-release-dates-dog-stars-devil-wears-prada-1236409088/ |archive-date=May 22, 2025 |access-date=May 22, 2025 |website=[[Deadline Hollywood|Deadline]]}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |last1=Jackson |first1=Angelique |last2=Saperstein |first2=Pat |title='The Devil Wears Prada' Sequel Set for May 2026; Ridley Scott's 'The Dog Stars' Dated for March |url=https://variety.com/2025/film/news/devil-wears-prada-2-may-2026-dog-stars-1236064250/ |website=[[Variety (magazine)|Variety]] |access-date=16 October 2025 |date=22 May 2025}}</ref>
